title: more dreams less details
content: recently, ever since posting more in this group, and trying to do research on mall world, ive been dreaming of mall world much more frequently than usual. im talking like, pretty much every night. weird thing is, i normally remember almost every detail. but now, i can hardly even remember small pieces. just flashes of places or very faint memory that i cant visualize could be unrelated, could be the reasoning, but before this started every mall dream was ending with the ‘police(?)’ chasing me and shooting me for something…
